27.04

The Order of the Broken Chain

Region: the Lands of the Night Cattle

<span lang="EN-US" style="font-size:9.0pt;font-family:"CenturyGothic","sans-serif"; color:black;mso-themecolor:text1">Connects to: [29.14](/wiki/29-14/), [33.00](/wiki/33-00/), [33.01](/wiki/33-01/) and [34.01](/wiki/34-01/). </span>

Overview

<span lang="EN-US" style="font-size:9.0pt;font-family:"CenturyGothic","sans-serif"; color:black;mso-themecolor:text1">Somewhere along the Welt Road, beneath the Lands of the Night Cattle, there is a secret lair where a strange society of revolutionaries lurks. This organization was founded by a slave from Titan's Rest ([33.01](/wiki/33-01/)) named Ancient Meg. Having lived to the age of 119, Ancient Meg had accumulated a truly incredible amount of silver in her body (see [34.01](/wiki/34-01/)). All the profits from her death were bound up in a complex will, to be executed by a barrister named Arian Alders from the City of Shuttered Windows. The will stipulated that the money would be used to form an underground organization dedicated to overthrowing the dwarves of the Titan's Skull ([33.00](/wiki/33-00/)) and free the slaves there. </span>

<span lang="EN-US" style="font-size:9.0pt;font-family:"CenturyGothic","sans-serif"; color:black;mso-themecolor:text1">Alders believed he was onto a good thing, being able to pay himself a wage as 'Grandmaster of the Order' without doing much else except dwelling in the Lands of the Night Cattle. However, he was not expecting the initial payment to be followed by several more from the wills of other slaves. In order to retain his wage, Alders was forced to begin actually doing the work that Ancient Meg had set out for him. He began hiring warriors and other agents and considering plans for raids upon Titan's Rest. When the dwarves got word of this they were furious, and threatened to cut off their supply of luminescent cave mushrooms to the Night Men. Thus, the Night Men drove Alders and his band of mercenaries off their land, which led to the establishment of the secret base they inhabit today.</span>

<span lang="EN-US" style="font-size:9.0pt;font-family:"CenturyGothic","sans-serif"; color:black;mso-themecolor:text1">Today, the Order of the Broken Chain consists of over sixty members, twenty-two of whom are volunteers and the rest being mercenaries. Bolstered by regular payments from the wills of argyric slaves, they have made two successful raids on Titan's Rest and freed almost a hundred slaves, some of whom have subsequently become volunteer members of the Order themselves. The mastermind behind all this is still Arian Alders, who is making good money out of it but whose colleagues in the Shuttered City now look upon him with distaste.</span>

Hooks

<span lang="EN-US" style="font-size:9.0pt;font-family:"CenturyGothic","sans-serif"; color:black;mso-themecolor:text1">-How did Ancient Meg live to be so old in the terrible working conditions of the mines? </span>

<span lang="EN-US" style="font-size:9.0pt;font-family:"CenturyGothic","sans-serif"; color:black;mso-themecolor:text1">-Why didn't Alders just take the money and run? Does the will hold some special power? </span>

<span lang="EN-US" style="font-size:9.0pt;font-family:"CenturyGothic","sans-serif"; color:black;mso-themecolor:text1">-Why do the Night Men need luminescent cave mushrooms so much? </span>

<span lang="EN-US" style="font-size:9.0pt;font-family:"CenturyGothic","sans-serif"; color:black;mso-themecolor:text1">-What was in this cave before the Order arrived? Anything of interest? </span>

<span lang="EN-US" style="font-size:9.0pt;font-family:"CenturyGothic","sans-serif"; color:black;mso-themecolor:text1">-Any notable characters amongst the Order's members? </span>

<span lang="EN-US" style="font-size:9.0pt;font-family:"CenturyGothic","sans-serif"; color:black;mso-themecolor:text1">-What does Arian Alders think of all this? Has he been converted to the cause or is he still only in it for the money? </span>
